_readme: Foreigner checklist per venue slug. Only facts already read on the venue's OFFICIAL page (the venue page's source + check date). Venue email replies are NOT used here. Missing key = Not confirmed. Keys: tattoo, card (foreign card payment), english (English booking/staff), dropin (open to visitors without a room/membership).

grand-josun-busan.tattoo: Tattoos 15cm or larger must be covered with a patch. Not coverable = no entry.
